title: Unisex Pit Bull – Professional Lap Dog Embroidered Zip Hoodie

seo.title: Pitbull Lover Zip Up Hoodie – Professional Lap Dog
seo.description: A pitbull lover zip up hoodie: PROFESSIONAL LAP DOG (72 LBS) on the back over a grinning pit bull in an armchair, plus an embroidered pit bull on the chest.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

This pitbull lover zip up hoodie is for the pit bull owner whose 72-pound lap dog has never accepted that he is not a lapdog, zipped on for the dog park and the couch.

A grinning grey pit bull with its tongue out sits like a person in a floral armchair under a crocheted blanket, in grey, blush, sage and cream with a worn print texture. PROFESSIONAL runs above it and LAP DOG with (72 LBS) below in heavy engraved serif capitals, the second block wider than the first: cream and coral on Black and Navy, slate and brick red on Ash. The full print is on the back. On the front, a small grinning pit bull head with its tongue out is embroidered on the left chest, and the words 72 LBS are stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest pit bull head and left-cuff 72 LBS, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 3 colors: Black, Navy and Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

How does the Professional Lap Dog zip hoodie fit?
The Professional Lap Dog pitbull lover zip up hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a regular unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy layer over a tee, or go up one for a roomier fit. The first size exchange within 30 days is free.

Is this pitbull lover hoodie warm enough for chilly dog parks?
It is a mid-weight layer. The Graphic Tees Co. zip hoodie is a Gildan 18600 in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, soft inside and outside, with a metal zipper, front pouch pockets and an unlined hood. It handles chilly dog parks, couch nights with a heavy lap dog and the walk home well.

Where are the print and the embroidery on this zip hoodie?
The full design, PROFESSIONAL above the dog and LAP DOG (72 LBS) below, is printed across the back so the zipper never splits it. On the front, a small grinning pit bull head with its tongue out sits on the left chest with no words, and 72 LBS is stitched on the left cuff.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and do not iron over the stitching. The pit bull head on the chest and the 72 LBS cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash with gentle care.

Is it a good gift for a pit bull owner, and when should I order for Christmas?
Yes, for the friend whose big dog sits on her lap like it is nothing. Graphic Tees Co. makes each embroidered hoodie to order, so for Christmas order by about December 8. Orders over $45 ship free in the US, and one free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
